renterSafety.line: We ask every renter for a government photo ID. It keeps our games and your party safe.
renterSafety.rentalFormNote: The request form takes about three minutes and needs a Google sign-in for the ID upload.
renterSafety.provenance: Owner-approved 2026-10-14; owner ruling 2026-10-15: the photo ID stays required; the social media link is optional and is described only on the form itself, never on the site or in docs. contact.html carries the line through scripts/lib/contact_surface.js; rentals/index.html through scripts/generators/build_rentals_page.js.

entity.provenance: Owner-approved 2026-10-16: the site, the Google Business Profile and the Facebook Page are one entity. Every page carries exactly one business node with this @id (sameAs = Facebook Page + Maps cid, hasMap = Maps cid); every other node references it by @id. Service-area business: no street address is public, so none is published. priceRange $$ because the site publishes starting prices (pricing.html). Guarded by scripts/validators/validate_business_entity.js.

businessTypes.provenance: Added 2026-10-10. The Google Business Profile category is Party planner (see contact.googleBusinessProfileProvenance), and Search Console's only impressions (11 Sep-8 Oct 2026) are party-planner queries. schema.org has no party-planner or decorator type, so LocalBusiness carries Wikidata classes: Q1419997 'event producer' (person specializing in planning and execution of parties, events...; the class Wikidata resolves 'party planner' and 'event planner' to) and Q22811707 'decorator' (person who decorates for a living). Resolved via wbsearchentities on 2026-10-10.

primaryRoute.why: The page for the party-planner queries Search Console shows impressions for. scripts/lib/contact_surface.js puts it in the footer of every page (owner ruling 2026-10-13: not in the header nav); validate:contact-surface asserts both.
